Download **AutobahnRush.apk** below, open it on your Android phone and allow installing apps from this source when asked.

- Polizei got serious: a police helicopter follows the chase (and searchlights you at night), SEK vans join and ram, more patrol cars, spike strips across the road ahead that shred your tyres, and police hits now really hurt
- Country roads fixed: the whole road network is planned well ahead, so fields, farms, lakes and trees no longer end up on roads or ramps; no more flickering where roads overlap; stricter checks for fields

If no release key is configured yet (see docs/ANDROID.md), the APK is debug-signed and an update may need the old version uninstalled first.
